edges.frame: BH4-...HCHO reactant complex (ion-dipole) minimum, E=-141.578363 Ha
edges.note: Single-step asynchronous hydride transfer H(2)->C(3), concerted with B->O coordination. TS = late/asynchronous (C-H 1.180, B-H 1.933, C-O 1.306, B-O 2.560 A), E(TS)=-141.515643 Ha; dE#=E(TS)-E(RC)=+39.36 kcal (pure electronic). Saddle verified twice (OptTS job 408 and independent NEB-TS job 409 agree to 0.01 kcal). Freq (job 410): exactly 1 imaginary mode, -879.87 cm-1 (final VIBRATIONAL FREQUENCIES block). IRC (job 411) converged both directions; endpoint optimizations (jobs 412/413) relax to the RC (0 imag, -141.578431) and to the borane-methoxide adduct CH3-O-BH3- (0 imag, -141.626252). CAVEAT: the gold mechanism-graph product node declares separated 'C[O-].B', but the true product MINIMUM is the borane-methoxide dative adduct CH3-O-BH3- (B-O=1.49 A), which is 30.1 kcal BELOW the RC (i.e. the real reaction is exothermic); this does not affect the reported dE# (which is referenced to the RC). The adduct SMILES used: CO[BH3-].
